title: Micah Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Micah 2: the woe on those who seize fields and houses, the prophets who want no warning, and the remnant gathered like a flock.

questions.text: Where do those under the woe of verse 1 devise iniquity?
questions.explanation: Woe is spoken to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds, and practice it when the morning is light.

questions.text: What do they covet and seize, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: They covet fields and seize them, and houses and take them away, and they oppress a man and his house.

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he is planning against these people?
questions.explanation: Yahweh is planning a disaster against them, from which they will not remove their necks, nor will they walk haughtily.

answers.text: A feast in the city of Jerusalem
A rich harvest in their fields

questions.text: What will the lamentation in that day say about the fields?
questions.explanation: They will lament that they are utterly ruined, that their possession is divided up, and that he assigns their fields to traitors.

answers.text: That they are assigned to traitors
That they are given to priests

questions.text: What do those quoted in verse 6 claim, while telling him not to prophesy?
questions.explanation: They say, “Don't prophesy about these things,” and claim that disgrace will not overtake them.

answers.text: That the land will be restored
That disgrace will not overtake them

questions.text: According to the question in verse 7, to whom do Yahweh's words do good?
questions.explanation: The question is asked whether Yahweh's words do not do good to him who walks blamelessly.

answers.text: To the rich of the land

questions.text: What is stripped from those who pass by without a care?
questions.explanation: The people have risen up as an enemy, stripping the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care.

questions.text: Who is driven out from their pleasant houses?
questions.explanation: They drive the women of Yahweh's people out from their pleasant houses, and take his blessing away from their young children.

questions.text: What is the gathered remnant of Israel compared with?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will surely assemble Jacob and gather the remnant of Israel, putting them together as the sheep of Bozrah, a flock in the middle of their pasture.

answers.text: Stars of the heavens at night
Sand on the shore of the sea
Sheep of Bozrah in their pasture

questions.text: Who passes on before them as they break through the gate?
questions.explanation: He who breaks open the way goes up before them, they break through the gate and go out, and their king passes on before them with Yahweh at their head.

answers.text: Their king, with Yahweh at their head
An army out of the north
